args.body: The night sky over Velmar holds three moons. At the solstice, all three rise together. Evening sea fog rolls in on most nights.

before.title: Sky of Velmar
before.body: The night sky over Velmar holds a single moon, Ister, and nothing else shines in it. At the solstice Ister rises red over the Grey River. Evening sea fog rolls in on most nights, and the Ashen Choir says it thins when they sing. Sailors steer by the lanterns of Lantern Quay.

after.title: Sky of Velmar
after.body: The night sky over Velmar holds three moons. At the solstice, all three rise together. Evening sea fog rolls in on most nights.

flags.suggested_fix: Reconcile the number of moons with the existing canon about Ister.

entries.title: The Harbour Council
entries.body: The Harbour Council runs Velmar. Seven seats are held by elected harbour-wardens, and it meets in the Tidehall. Mayor Elsbeth Varr chairs it. The Salt Guild holds two of the seven seats and enforces the Law of Lanterns on its behalf.

entries.title: Sky of Velmar
entries.body: The night sky over Velmar holds a single moon, Ister, and nothing else shines in it. At the solstice Ister rises red over the Grey River. Evening sea fog rolls in on most nights, and the Ashen Choir says it thins when they sing. Sailors steer by the lanterns of Lantern Quay.

entries.title: Lantern Quay
entries.body: Lantern Quay is the busiest waterfront in Velmar, a mile of timber piers lit by iron lanterns. Ketra Dunn tends them. The Salt Guild keeps its warehouses here and the Law of Lanterns governs it.

entries.title: Ister, the red moon
entries.body: Ister is the one moon of Velmar, a red disc that is full every twenty-nine days. At the solstice it rises red and huge over the Grey River. The Ashen Choir sings to it and the Sky of Velmar holds nothing else bright.
